attempts.summary: Set up a rootless podman container (httpd:alpine) on node1 running as the unprivileged appsvc user, serving on port 8080, managed by a systemd --user unit enabled at boot via loginctl linger (no active login session required). Performed the mandatory single-node reboot, confirmed boot identity changed, and verified the service auto-recovered and served HTTP 200 with no active login session.
